title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller in Wrexham, you will manage customer accounts within the Industrial / Manufacturing sector, helping the finance function keep records accurate and payments on track. You will handle day-to-day credit control work and provide clear account information that helps the business run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Industrial & Manufacturing sector in Wrexham. They are fairly well known in the area and have a strong reputation.

Description
- Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and maintain accurate account records.
- Contact customers to follow up on outstanding payments and agree practical next steps.
- Review aged debt reports and prioritise accounts that need timely action.
- Investigate payment queries and work with relevant colleagues to resolve them.
- Keep clear notes of customer contact, payment promises and account updates.
- Issue customer statements and provide information on account balances when needed.
- Reconcile customer payments against invoices to keep records up to date.
- Share regular debt updates with the Accounting & Finance department to support informed decisions.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Experience managing customer accounts and following up overdue payments.
- Confidence reviewing account balances, invoices and payment information.
- Ability to investigate payment queries and keep account records accurate.
- Clear written and verbal communication when dealing with customers.
- Good attention to detail when recording payment activity and account updates.
- Ability to organise workload and prioritise outstanding debt effectively.

Job Offer
- Permanent Credit Controller position based in Wrexham.
- Salary of 27,000 to 33,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Excellent benefits package including enhanced pension and private healthcare.
- Really accessible location with plenty of free parking on site and close to local public transport routes.
- Full time role - 37.5 hours per week.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Site Administrator
description:
Discover Tradebe

Tradebe is a group of industrial businesses with the commitment of creating a more sustainable planet and making significant contributions to human wellbeing. In the UK, we are leaders focused on recycling, energy recovery and circular economy, managing all different environmental liabilities in a sustainable way.

What will you do? Make an impact!

We're looking for a proactive and organised Site Administrator to support the day-to-day operation of our busy site. You'll be responsible for SAP administration, purchase order processing, data entry, document control, customer service and office administration, ensuring accurate records and efficient business support across the site. Working closely with operational and management teams, you'll coordinate communications, meetings, reporting and compliance documentation while helping to maintain the smooth running of site activities. This role is ideal for an experienced administrator with strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What you'll be doing:

Providing administrative support to a busy waste management and operations team.
Maintaining accurate records, data entry and document control using SAP.
Processing and reconciling Hazardous Waste Consignment Notes (HWCNs) and associated documentation.
Supporting invoicing, billing administration and month-end reconciliation activities.
Managing customer service enquiries relating to collections, deliveries and invoices.
Updating customer accounts and maintaining accurate SAP records.
Coordinating compliance documentation and regulatory paperwork.
Liaising with transport, plant and operational teams to ensure accurate processing of waste management records.
Assisting with customer account setup and sales administration activities.
Producing, processing and issuing consignment notes and supporting documentation.
Promoting a positive health, safety and environmental culture and reporting any incidents or concerns.
Providing general office administration and business support to ensure the efficient running of the site.

Do you have what it takes?

Strong communication, customer service and interpersonal skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
Previous administration experience, including data entry and reporting.
Able to work independently and manage own workload.
Self-motivated, reliable and proactive.
Well-organised, with the ability to prioritise and multitask in a fast-paced environment.
Able to meet deadlines and handle confidential information with discretion.

We expect from you to Be accountable, Drive results, Embrace Change, and high levels of Collaboration!

What's in for you?

Salary up to £26,000 + bonus
6% Contributory Pension
A range of benefits (access to our benefits platform for discounts and cash back on shopping purchases, gyms and leisure activities, cycle to work scheme and dedicated wellbeing centre)

Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

If this offer does not match your expectations, but you would like to develop your career in a company that promotes circular economy and sustainability, register on our Career Page, and don't miss out on new job opportunities!

Tradebe is committed to guaranteeing selection processes based on merit and skills free of any bias based on age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or nationality. We believe in equal opportunities, and we work for it.
